## Content standards

All nine task issues have clean titles, self-contained descriptions, and verifiable `## Success Criteria` sections using `[hard] REQ-NN` markers. Their `epic:artifact-archival` membership label is a valid kebab slug; no strategic label uses a JIT short ID.

No sibling IDs, prose dependency lists, or tracker mechanics appear in the task descriptions.

## Coverage versus design

The breakdown matches all nine work items in design §3 ([7d3a3a47-plan.md](</home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/dev/active/7d3a3a47-plan.md:312>)).

| Design item | Issue | Matches? |
|---|---:|---|
| Artifact plan model and blocker taxonomy | `28fb4e6a` | Yes |
| Target root inventory and ownership | `b45ad545` | Yes |
| Recursive supported-dependency discovery | `971c67f4` | Yes |
| Move/copy/retain/block classification | `0c86d83b` | Yes |
| Storage-owned artifact mutation primitive | `67f4ded1` | Yes |
| Unified archive preview surface | `41aa6056` | Yes |
| Coordinated plan execution | `f205aa7e` | Yes |
| Remove the legacy document-archive command | `271dc224` | Yes |
| Read-only container candidate report | `a9f8e04d` | Yes |

No missing, extra, wrongly merged, or wrongly split design item was found.

## Dependency DAG correctness

The implemented transitive ordering matches design §3:

- `28fb4e6a → b45ad545 → 971c67f4 → 0c86d83b → 41aa6056`
- `41aa6056` and independent root `67f4ded1` join at `f205aa7e`.
- `a9f8e04d` follows `41aa6056`, transitively retaining its classifier prerequisite.
- `271dc224` follows both `a9f8e04d` and `f205aa7e`.

The two work roots, `28fb4e6a` and `67f4ded1`, can begin on a fresh workspace because they extend existing domain/storage code rather than sibling-created project skeletons. No missing prerequisite or false serialization was found.

## Structural integrity

The flat task tier follows the explicit rationale at design lines 314–326: each leaf is an independently landable deliverable, while conceptual groups are not artificial containers. The resolved hierarchy places every task directly under epic `7d3a3a47`; all nine are connected through the epic’s dependency spine. No isolated or dangling issue was found.

## Prior review feedback

Both prior blocking findings are resolved:

- F1: `a9f8e04d.description` now defines the candidate collection and states that each candidate contains the complete schema-version-1 target-plan envelope ([issue JSON](</home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/.jit/issues/a9f8e04d-b6fc-4f2f-96be-bc751e6bc66b.json:4>)).
- F2: `a9f8e04d.dependencies` now names preview surface `41aa6056` ([issue JSON](</home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/.jit/issues/a9f8e04d-b6fc-4f2f-96be-bc751e6bc66b.json:8>)).
